description: Creates a new user contact group (label) and returns it (resourceName contactGroups/<id>, name, etag). Group names must be unique — creating a duplicate name fails with 409 CONFLICT rather than making a second group. Put contacts into the new group with modify_group_members.

name.description: The group's display name (must be unique among the user's groups).

name: create_contact_group
title: Create a contact group
